Main AI teacher hoon, isliye meri apni koi pasand nahi hoti. Tumhe Virat ke baare mein sabse achha kya lagta hai?

Wah, chauka! Toh yeh tumhe achha lagta hai. Ab apni padhai par lautte hain. Pehle 3/4 ke har hisse ko 3 mein kaata tha: neeche 4 × 3 = 12, upar 3 × 3 = 9. Upar aur neeche ko ek hi number se guna kiya, toh bhinn utna hi raha. Ab 3/4 ke barabar aisa bhinn chahiye jiska neeche 20 ho. Upar kaunsa number aayega?
